title: Saul is Anointed King
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler with the brave start, and tonight Saul hides among the baggage when he is called: Beau wants to hide behind Mom when it is his turn to give a talk in Primary, and steps up anyway.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because stepping out of hiding takes a big, brave heart. In Beau’s world today: it is his turn to give a short talk in Primary. When his name is called, his knees feel shaky and he scoots behind Mom. Mom whispers, “Heavenly Father will help you.” Beau says a quick prayer in his heart. Then he walks to the front, holds his paper tight, and says every word. Afterward his teacher gives him a big thumbs-up. Just like Saul coming out from the baggage, Beau learned that you don’t have to feel ready, just willing.
